rules.name: security
rules.reason: Security, auth and secrets work never goes to a free model under this repository's credential rules

rules.name: plan
rules.reason: Planning and splitting an epic needs the owner's answers, steered from the phone

rules.name: design
rules.reason: Screenshots need the owner's eye, steered from the phone

rules.name: review
rules.reason: An independent second opinion, on a different model from the Sonnet that writes the feature

rules.name: chore
rules.reason: A small chore, docs or tests ticket on a free model, nearly free unattended

fallback.reason: A feature or fix across several files, and anything unlabelled, on the reliable default
